articles.headline: Kick It Out: Discrimination 'deeply embedded' in football, reports up 25%
articles.description: Discrimination remains "deeply embedded" in English football, the chief executive of Kick It Out has said, with reports up 25%  last season compared to the prior campaign.

articles.headline: Ex-Arsenal midfielder Aaron Ramsey named Oxford United manager
articles.description: Aaron Ramsey has stepped into management by taking the reins at Oxford United.

articles.headline: Notts County beat David Beckham's Salford in League Two playoff final
articles.description: Sir David Beckham made an unhappy Wembley Stadium return as Notts County beat the Salford side he co-owns 3-0 to win the League Two playoff final.

related.headline: Can Wrexham really reach the Premier League against all odds?
related.title: Can Wrexham really reach the Premier League against all odds?
related.linkText: Against all odds, Wrexham keep climbing. Can they really reach the Premier League?

article.story:
Wrexham earned a 1-0 victory over Mansfield Town on Saturday as they continue their promotion bid in League One.

Wrexham took the lead after just six minutes. Midfielder Ryan Barnett collected a knock down around 30 yards from the Mansfield goal before driving forward and firing a shot from just outside the box and into the bottom left corner.

Despite the early goal, Mansfield dominated for much of the game but were unable to hit back and level the scores.

The result ends a run of three games without a win in all competitions for Wrexham, who were dumped out of the FA Cup in the first round following a 1-0 defeat to League Two side Harrogate Town last weekend.
